newsitem.title: UK: South Beach rises to premium on AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: South Beach rises to premium on AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in health-conscious South Beach Cafe Plc on Tuesday crept to a four per cent premium to the their issue price on their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
South Beach shares, issued at 6p, nudged a 1/4p higher to 6-1/4p by 1006 GMT in thin trade.
"I've seen a couple of nibblers on the buy side but overall it has been pretty quiet," said one dealer.
South Beach, valued at around 9.7 million stg at the issue price, raised 1.8 million stg which it said will be used to expand the number of cafes and provide extra working capital.

The company has opened two art-deco style cafes on the campus of Michigan State University and a third in London's Baker Street. Its menu includes pumpernickel bagels and "Pompano Punch" - a cold, fresh pineapple, banana, kiwi and grape drink.
